message:
Now I need to understand the vulnerability. The `rx_icmp` function copies `pkt->pay.len` bytes into the TX buffer. The TX buffer size is limited. Let me look at how the TX buffer is allocated and what its size is. Let me also look at the `mip.c` version and the driver:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "tx.buf\|tx.len\|MIP_TX\|tx_buf\|tx_len" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/mongoose/mongoose.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
